ValidationRule.description: All Accounts under the Country Parent should have the same IM Country Code and IM Sector as the Country Parent."
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "IME_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IM_Custom Sys Admin",
NOT(ISBLANK(ParentId)),
OR( ISPICKVAL( Division , "Europe"), ISPICKVAL(Division , "Latin America"), ISPICKVAL(Division , "Asia Pacific") ),
TEXT(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c) <> "Country Parent",
OR(TEXT(IM_Country_Code__c) <> TEXT(Parent.IM_Country_Code__c), TEXT(IM_Sector__c) <> TEXT(Parent.IM_Sector__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All Accounts under the Country Parent should have the same "IM Country Code" and "IM Sector" as the Country Parent.
